# Task Routing

Use this file to decide where Copilot should look first.

- Need first pixels on screen → `examples/basic-triangle.md`
- Need 3D textured object → `examples/textured-cube.md`
- Shader compile or link errors → `patterns/shader-compilation.md`
- Wrong geometry, broken colors, bad UVs → `patterns/buffers-and-attributes.md`
- Texture not showing → `patterns/textures.md`
- Camera or transform issue → `patterns/matrices-and-camera.md`
- Animation loop issue → `patterns/render-loop.md`
- Production robustness → `patterns/context-loss.md`
- Performance tuning → `patterns/performance.md`
- Constant or API lookup → `reference.md`
